```artifact
Feature: Software Engineering Process Coordination

  Scenario: Coordinate activities in the Software Engineering process
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department are guiding the process
    When activities are coordinated
    Then the Software Engineering process is successfully executed

  Scenario: Provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    When a patient requests a medicine
    Then the authorized Chemist provides the medicine at a discounted price

  Scenario: Provide door-step Laboratory services
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services
    When a patient requests a laboratory test
    Then the specimen is collected at the patient's doorstep

  Scenario Outline: Coordinate activities in the Software Engineering process with different staff members
    Given Prof. <staff_member> and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department are guiding the process
    When activities are coordinated
    Then the Software Engineering process is successfully executed
    Examples:
      | staff_member |
      | Prof. Chandrasekaran |
      | Other staff member 1 |
      | Other staff member 2 |

  Scenario Outline: Provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists with different medicine prices
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    When a patient requests a medicine with price <price>
    Then the authorized Chemist provides the medicine at a discounted price
    Examples:
      | price |
      | 10.0  |
      | 20.0  |
      | 50.0  |

  Scenario Outline: Provide door-step Laboratory services with different laboratory test types
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services
    When a patient requests a laboratory test of type <test_type>
    Then the specimen is collected at the patient's doorstep
    Examples:
      | test_type |
      | Blood test |
      | Urine test |
      | X-ray test |
```
